author: Rachael Kauffman
title: Missouri woman dies following ATV crash in Iowa - NewsBreak
text:
By Rachael Kauffman ,
7 hours ago
OSKALOOSA, Iowa -- Authorities say a Missouri woman was thrown from her ATV and died at an Iowa park last week.
The Iowa Department of Natural Resources says 26-year-old Emily Turner of Jamesport, Missouri, was involved in an ATV crash at Bluff Creek OHV Park, which is located southwest of Oskaloosa, on August 8.
4 charged in downtown Des Moines assault that left 1 hospitalized According to officials, Turner had been operating a four-wheel all-terrain vehicle (ATV) on a popular track at the ATV and off-road motorcycle park around 8 p.m. when she lost control and was thrown from the machine.
The Mahaska County Sheriff's Office, Eddyville Fire Responders, and Iowa DNR all responded to the incident, where crews began immediate life-saving measures. Authorities say Turner was taken to an area hospital, where she was pronounced dead later that night.
The Iowa DNR says the incident remains under investigation.
Bluff Creek OHV Park is a 350-acre state park equipped with campgrounds and riding trails designed to accommodate dirt bikes, quads, and ATVs. There are several trails that present various difficulty levels, such as steep hill climbs, deep pits, and four motocross tracks.
